title: Thread scheduling
description: Scheduling of the thread that runs a robotdriver/robotsimulator.

policy.description: Scheduling policy. SCHED_OTHER keeps the default Linux scheduler (the thread scheduling is not modified), suitable without a real-time kernel. SCHED_FIFO (first-in first-out) and SCHED_RR (round-robin) are real-time schedulers that require a real-time kernel (or the appropriate rtprio limits).

priority.description: Priority of the thread. Ignored for SCHED_OTHER. For SCHED_FIFO and SCHED_RR it must be between 1 (lowest) and 98 (highest); 99 is reserved for critical system threads (e.g. watchdogs).
